notes.title: DLC trains available. New free update: Wellbeing
notes.notes:
Hello Urbekites,

After a lot of work the trains DLC is finally available

 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2696580/Urbek_City_Builder__Trains/

Also, a free update to the base game: welfare. It has new builds and the possibility to edit your saved maps, which is something the community had been asking me for a long time (thanks for your feedback!).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/26440475e6d4e0428c43afc0b1a60fd1fcd76dd6.png

New buildings

 Fire station: with a fire truck
 Pharmacy
 Urban forest
 Mental Health Center
 Therapeutic community
 Psychiatric hospital


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/37ffc15e9830a544ada0dccb225846ea53aa5368.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/b13d33fd922ae72c80394f7e2f3211b3dc7e0f76.png

And as always, many thanks to the community for the ideas and support, which allow us to keep working on this game and adding more content.

If you want to be part of Urbek, enter to Urbek's discord:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39262571/c68e33a949adffa14b71a4c36aae9be0389d88bf.png

notes.title: 🚀 Release date Reveal !!! Urbek will be available on July 13th 🚀
notes.notes:
Hello Urbekitas,

The big release day of Urbek: City Builder is coming up, July 13th! Thank you very much for your feedback, it will always be essential for us to make the game together.

In less than a month you will be able to play the full version of Urbek: City Builder! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/6bbad2523a57d499b656376c50ef57eeb19b56f9.png

It's been a lot of work to get this game. There are 5 different levels, more than 200 types of constructions and 1000 different models, from the 10 different models of stilt houses to the 4 cyclists that you will see riding in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/546cd9d720050705acbcab0f22a0bf8058873219.png
